title: Intel 82575 PCIe x1 Quad RJ45 Gigabit Ethernet Network Interface Card

items.h: Model: Intel 82575 PCIe x1 Quad RJ45 Gigabit NIC

tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
Experience enterprise-grade networking performance with the Intel 82575 PCIe x1 Quad RJ45 Gigabit Ethernet Network Interface Card, now available in Bangladesh at D CORE.

Powered by Intel’s reliable 82575 controller, this Quad-Port Gigabit Server Adapter provides high-speed data transmission, network load balancing, and superior connectivity for servers, workstations, and IT infrastructures.

Each of the four RJ45 Gigabit ports supports 10/100/1000 Mbps speeds with automatic detection, ensuring seamless performance across multiple networks. Designed for professionals, it supports Windows, Linux, and VMware ESXi, making it ideal for data centers, NAS systems, routers, and virtualization platforms.

Key Features


  • Intel 82575 chipset for stable and high-performance data transmission
  • Quad-Port (4x RJ45) Gigabit Ethernet for multi-network connections
  • PCI Express x1 interface for fast and efficient communication
  • Supports VLAN, QoS, and load balancing technologies
  • Compatible with Windows Server, Linux, and VMware
  • Ideal for virtualization, storage servers, and enterprise networking
  • Energy-efficient design with advanced offload features

Applications


  • Data centers and enterprise servers
  • Network virtualization and cloud environments
  • Firewall and routing appliances
  • Multi-port NAS and security systems


Technical Specifications


  • Model: Intel 82575 PCIe x1 Quad RJ45 Gigabit NIC
  • Chipset:  Intel 82575
  • Interface: PCI Express x1
  • Ports: 4 × RJ45 (10/100/1000 Mbps)
  • Controller: Intel Ethernet Controller 82575
  • Network Standards: IEEE 802.3, 802.3u, 802.3ab
  • Compatibility: Windows, Linux, VMware ESXi
  • Features: VLAN, QoS, Load Balancing, Wake-on-LAN
  • Bracket: Full-height & Low-profile included
